company.name: Carbic
company.shortDescription: Carbic builds sensor technology to monitor flow behavior in fluid systems.
company.description: Carbic is a full service technology company that provides software and hardware for oil and gas companies. Their mission is to reduce risks and cut costs by using an expertly architected breakthrough technology. To achieve this, they use a breakthrough system of modular sensor components and server-based software to deliver data-driven results that enable customers to easily monitor all their fluids remotely, collect key data, and maximize the impact of that data.

productsAndServices.description: A universal ultrasonic sensor that monitors fluid flow in pipes from 2" to 24" diameter, providing real-time data via integrated digital and satellite transmission.
productsAndServices.name: Ultrasonic Flow Sensor

productsAndServices.description: A software platform that collects, processes, and displays real-time flow data from sensors, enabling analysis and operational decision-making.
productsAndServices.name: Flow Monitoring Software Platform

productsAndServices.description: Services that enable integration of various digital-output sensors with Carbic’s data transmission and processing technologies for remote monitoring.
productsAndServices.name: Sensor Data Integration Services
